Nogometni klub Celje, commonly referred to as NK Celje or simply Celje, is a professional football club based in Celje, Slovenia. Founded in 1919, the club competes in the Slovenian PrvaLiga, the top tier of Slovenian football. Together with Maribor, Celje are the only club to have participated in every season of the PrvaLiga since the competition was established in 1991.
